name: Ryan Martinez
headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
summary: Full stack engineer with 6+ years building business software, from SaaS warehouse systems to manufacturing apps that hundreds of people use every shift. At Glenair I help replace a decades-old terminal system with React, TypeScript and Python, and set the frontend standards for a team of 10 to 15 engineers.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
experience.intro: Modernization (MCU) team replacing "Borg", the company's legacy ASCII terminal system, with React, TypeScript, Python and SQL Server web apps.
bullets: Built the quality control app used by 250 inspectors on 35,000 jobs a month: guided step-by-step inspections, customer requirement checks, trace validation, NCR, NCMR and MRB workflows, and certificates of conformance.

Built the stock picking app for 50 warehouse staff handling 15,000 picks a month, with inventory verification, trace history from stock to customer order, and a permission-gated admin console for resolving issues.
Built and migrated the 12M+ document company archive (30 years) to SQL Server and on-premises MinIO storage; new indexing cut searches from 10+ seconds to about 200 ms.

Set the team's frontend standards: created the template repository every new app starts from and a shared npm package, published by GitHub Actions, with authentication, navigation, global search, notifications, settings, widgets and strictly typed clients for 70 internal APIs.
Helped move the backend boilerplate from Flask to FastAPI, started a shared Python API package, and am helping adopt pytest and Playwright.
Mentored 12 engineers (5+ interns and 7 new hires): plan and delegate their work and review every change they commit.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
bullets: Shipped enhancements to a SaaS warehouse management system (AngularJS, Java, PostgreSQL) running in 20+ large warehouses.
Took over building and rolling out customer deployments on AWS (EC2, RDS), including a Dockerized Python RF scanner app that floor staff used to move inventory between locations.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Contract)
bullets: Built custom EDI pipelines in .NET (C#) for 10+ medical records trading partners, mapping each partner's format to standard EDI and back, and verified every mapping with test cases.

earlier.title: IT Intern
earlier.line: Helpdesk support; automated legacy system syncs with Apps Script.

earlier.title: Lead Code Instructor
earlier.line: Taught Python, Java and C++; coached new instructors.

projects.name: ry-mart.com
projects.line: Personal site on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2 (React Router, TypeScript): blog editor behind Cloudflare Access that publishes through a GitHub App, photo uploads, and CI with Playwright end-to-end tests.

projects.name: Online multiplayer volley game
projects.line: Real-time 1v1 over WebSockets with a server-run match on Durable Objects, client prediction and smoothing, and two-minute reconnects.

projects.name: Taco Trek race tracker
projects.line: Live GPS tracking for a 300-runner 50K: spectator map, race control dashboard and missed-checkpoint alerts on Workers and D1, with batched uploads to keep database writes low.
